intel.title: [CISA KEV] Zammad GmbH Zammad - Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-102490
廠商: Zammad GmbH
產品: Zammad
漏洞名稱: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
說明: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-10-05
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: 此情資指出開源客服系統 Zammad 存在權限管理不當漏洞（CVE-2026-102490），允許本地 zammad 使用者將權限提升至 root。該漏洞已被收錄於 CISA KEV 且傳出有活躍攻擊，但由於公司並未部署或使用 Zammad 相關系統，因此不受此漏洞影響。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Zammad GmbH Zammad - Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-102489
廠商: Zammad GmbH
產品: Zammad
漏洞名稱: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
說明: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-10-05
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Zammad 存在會話固定漏洞（CVE-2026-102489），攻擊者可藉此漏洞進行鏈結攻擊，以 zammad 使用者權限執行遠端程式碼（RCE）。此漏洞已被列入 CISA KEV 漏洞名單，顯示已有活躍的攻擊活動。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。
